annotations.title: Get a download package's progress and links

description: Use to check on one of the user's own download packages or estimates (the id from estimate_download or prepare_download). Read-only. Returns its state, its progress (files and bytes done, time left) and, for each finished ZIP part, a temporary link to download it that works for one hour. States: estimating, estimated, awaiting_approval, queued, building, ready, partial (some files missing; see missing), failed, cancelled, rejected, expired.
name: download_status
title: Get a download package's progress and links
